+# Incremental repository indexing
+
+Default-branch push jobs compare the current path-to-blob-SHA inventory with the
+last indexed inventory. Only new or changed blobs are re-parsed, re-chunked and
+re-embedded; deleted paths are removed, and identical blobs are untouched. The
+store applies file/chunk mutations and the new indexed head in one transaction,
+so a retry cannot expose a head SHA with only part of its mutations.

explanations.title: Plan only changed blobs
explanations.summary: The indexer can now compare a current path-to-SHA inventory with the previous one and produce a deterministic plan: unchanged files are skipped, changed or new files are upserted, and missing files are deleted. Invalid entries and duplicate current paths are rejected.

explanations.title: Apply the delta with its indexed head
explanations.summary: A planned delta and the new head SHA are passed to the store together with installation and repository IDs in a single call. This lets a store implementation apply the mutations and advance the indexed head as one operation; required identifiers are validated first.
